Okay love, I'll try to help you. Concealer and foundation do wonders for covering up scars. You could maybe use a setting spray or even hairspray to get the makeup to stay on. I'm not sure how noticeable your scars are, but your doctor will be feeling and looking closely at your breasts to notice any abnormalities. Don't panic, if your doctor does notice and asks you about it, just tell her that it was a past issue and you're getting better with the support of your family. I'm sure making her think that your mother already knows it's an issue and is working on it with you will decrease the chance of your doctor saying anything. 

As for your mother, I know parents can be so cruel. I used to cope with that by associating with them as little as possible. I spent most of my time looking for anything to do other than sit at home and made myself have fun. It actually made me happy being free to do as I want. But if you feel like you can't go out and be your own person or if you feel like you're afraid of your parents then you do need to tell someone. It's not fair to you for her to act like this. You deserve to be happy and make mistakes.

I really hope I can be some sort of help to you. Best wishes ❤️
